fact: The World Bank program document says the government "has launched" a national digital transformation strategy to expand broadband connectivity, modernise the legal and regulatory framework and invest in digital public infrastructure such as digital IDs and data exchange platforms; it names no adopting act or body, no date and no title, so the as_of is the document's published date.

The World Bank's GovTech dataset (2025 round) lists a GovTech or digital transformation strategy for Sao Tome and Principe, marked old and to be updated and dated 2020, linking a document on the national innovation institute's site (publisher-assessed); no adopting act is named.
The World Bank's GovTech dataset (2025 round) links the 2020 strategy to a document at inic.gov.st, an official site; the as-of is the 2020 year given.
